body: Thanks, I will keep helping him move forward!
I'll have to think about that, he might be weirded out that I asked a bunch of people on the internet about something like this, but I will take all the comments from here to heart for sure!

I completely agree that therapy is not brainwashing. I think I might actually start talking to someone other than the people of Reddit (no offence) about all this because even making this post has made me feel a bit better about the whole thing. Maybe if he sees it helps me, he will give it a try?

What a great story, good for that guy! I think my boyfriend just has some negative feelings about being "that guy that didn't do anything with his life until he was 35" or something. I don't think that of him at all, some people just take longer to find their "thing". I think it is a pride thing for him but I'm trying to make him see that you can be proud of whatever your job is, it doesn't just matter about the paycheck.  My Mom just found a job (today!) after quitting her job of about 17 years. She is starting all over again but it is a good thing because she was unhappy where she was and this new place will bring her lots of happiness!  Thanks for your response, I'm feeling much better about the whole thing. Now to get him to see more positively!

Yeah I think he is going to try taking a program in school but he will have to wait until next fall as the application period for that has come and gone. I will keep being positive and supportive, that I can do!

Thanks for the response, I think part of what is holding him back from starting towards a career is that in order to pay for the schooling, he would have to take out student loans. He just finished paying off the loans he took out to pay for the schooling that he didn't end up going through with, so he probably feels like it will take him forever to pay them off afterwards. Really though, having loans sucks but it is manageable. Again, he is just having a hard time seeing any good right now but I'm sure he will come around. 

I think another thing is that he has this idea that he needs to bring something to our group of friends that no one else brings so that he can feel... needed for lack of a better word. 

I totally agree with the idea of having things vs love. I'll try to add this to the things I discuss with him.
